# Slides

> Free host for AI-made HTML/CSS/JS presentation decks. No account required to publish.

Production: https://slides.availabooks.com
Source: https://github.com/availabooks/slides

## Agent skill

- [slides](https://slides.availabooks.com/skills/slides/SKILL.md): Upload a self-contained HTML deck with one POST. Load this whenever you need to host or share HTML/CSS/JS slides (Reveal.js, impress.js, or hand-written decks).

## Quick start

POST https://slides.availabooks.com/api/upload as multipart form data.

    curl -sS -X POST https://slides.availabooks.com/api/upload \
      -F mode=paste \
      -F html=@deck.html

Success (201): `{ "id", "slug", "url" }`. Give the user `url` (example `https://slides.availabooks.com/d/<id>/`).

Modes: `paste` (field `html`), `files` (repeat field `files`, include `index.html`), `zip` (field `zip`). Max ~10MB. No API key.

Do not invent other publish APIs. Optional custom slugs require a signed-in session; guests should omit `slug`.
